title: AUTHORIZATION: RBAC, ABAC, REBAC
subtitle: Authentication asks who you are. Authorization asks whether you may do this.
footer: System Design, Step by Step · core concepts

blocks.text: RBAC: roles grant permissions. ABAC: policy over attributes. ReBAC: paths in a relationship graph (Zanzibar).
Gateway authenticates; the service that owns the resource asks check(user, action, resource); deny by default; audit.

items: RBAC: a few coarse roles, admin consoles
One check per item when listing
One policy source, not scattered ifs
Cache with invalidation or consistency tokens
Lookup APIs to list what a user can see
Log every decision on sensitive data

blocks.text: "Sharing is Zanzibar-style: documents, folders, teams and users are tuples, the docs service calls check(user, view, doc) on every read with a short cache, admins are an RBAC role, and decisions are audit-logged."
